slide_title:
Sequence of 5 words
Positions are defined
as angles

layout.arrangement: A thin dark-red rectangular frame surrounds a light-gray canvas. Title block (three red bold lines, third line indented) sits top-left. Below it on the left is a small pale-yellow equation box. The right half of the slide (~45%–95% width) is dominated by a large pale-yellow circle with dotted red radial spokes (a 'clock-face' diagram); five rotated mint-green word chips sit on successive spokes counterclockwise from 3 o'clock (Word 0, 0°) up to ~11 o'clock (Word 4, ~120°), linked by four curved orange arrows each labeled '+ω'. A yellow oval slide-number badge '27' is in the top-right corner. A black letterbox bar runs along the very bottom edge (video artifact).

regions.content: Three-line red bold title: 'Sequence of 5 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles' (third line indented right, roughly under the middle of line 2)

layout.hierarchy: The radial diagram dominates visually, occupying roughly the right half of the slide (~45%–95% width, ~10%–95% height). The red bold title is the largest text. The yellow equation box is secondary. The five word chips, four '+ω' labels, and the '27' badge are the smallest elements; red is the dominant accent color.

visual_elements.description: Radial 'clock-face' coordinate diagram. Large pale-yellow filled circle (center ≈60% slide width, ≈53% slide height; radius ≈13.5% of slide width) with a thin gray-blue outline. Twelve dotted red radial spokes emanate from the center at 30° intervals, extending well beyond the rim (horizontal and vertical spokes are longest, nearly reaching the frame). Five small mint-green rectangular chips with thin green borders sit just outside the rim on successive spokes, each rotated to align with its spoke: 'Word 0' horizontal at 0° (right, ~78%/53%), 'Word 1' at ~35° (~76%/37%), 'Word 2' at ~65° (~69%/24%), 'Word 3' vertical reading bottom-to-top at 90° (top, ~60%/20%), 'Word 4' at ~120° (~51%/24%). Four thin curved orange arrows with small filled triangular arrowheads connect consecutive words counterclockwise (Word 0→1, 1→2, 2→3, 3→4), each arc paired with a red bold '+ω' label placed outside the arc (right of the Word 0-1 arc at ~85%/42%; above the Word 1-2 arc at ~80%/18%; above the Word 2-3 arc at ~66%/13%; above the Word 3-4 arc at ~54%/13%). Arrowheads point into the destination word chip. A black mouse cursor is overlaid near the circle center (~61%/42%).

Pale-yellow rectangular callout with a thin gray-olive border, three left-aligned lines: 'Sin(ω t)' with 'Sin' bold blue and '(ω t)' red; 'Cos(ω t)' with 'Cos' bold blue and '(ω t)' red; 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green.
Slide-number badge: small yellow filled oval with a dark navy outline containing '27' in dark bold text.

imagery: Standard black mouse-pointer arrow cursor overlaid slightly above-right of the circle's center (screen-capture artifact of a live software demo); no photos or illustrations otherwise.

colors.background: #EAEAEA (light gray inside the dark-red frame; white outside the frame; black #000000 letterbox bar at bottom)
colors.body_text: #009900 (green equation line) with #0000CC (blue Sin/Cos) and #CC0000 (red omega terms) as mixed runs

typography_notes: Entirely sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like). Title: bold, largest text (~26-28pt), red, three lines, third line indented. Equation box: bold ~16-18pt with per-word color runs (blue/red/green). Word chips: bold italic ~12pt green. '+ω' labels: bold ~14pt red. Slide number: bold ~14pt dark. No all-caps, no serif fonts, no numbered bullets.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built: all 5 word chips (Word 0-Word 4) and all 4 '+ω' arrows are visible simultaneously. A frozen mouse cursor near the circle center indicates a screen capture during a live demonstration; no mid-build state detected.
recreation_brief:
1. Background: set the entire slide background to white #FFFFFF.
2. Canvas: draw a rectangle inset ~6% from every edge, filled #EAEAEA (light gray), no outline — this is the canvas inside the frame.
3. Frame: draw a no-fill rectangle on exactly the canvas bounds with a thin (~1.5pt) dark-red #990000 outline.
4. Title: add a text box spanning ~7%–32% width and ~10%–25% height with three left-aligned lines — 'Sequence of 5 words' / 'Positions are defined' / 'as angles' — Arial bold 28pt, red #CC0000; indent line 3 ('as angles') by ≈6 characters so it starts roughly beneath the middle of line 2.
5. Equation box: draw a rectangle with top-left corner at ~8% width / ~33% height, ~15% wide and ~12% tall; fill #FFFFCC, thin (~1pt) gray-olive outline (exact hex not captured — use a muted gray-olive); inside, three left-aligned bold 18pt lines: 'Sin(ω t)' with 'Sin' in blue #0000CC and '(ω t)' in red #CC0000; 'Cos(ω t)' with 'Cos' in blue #0000CC and '(ω t)' in red #CC0000; 't=0,1,2,3,....' in green #009900.
6. Circle: draw an oval centered at 60% slide width / 53% slide height, diameter ~27% of slide width; fill pale yellow #FBFCC9, thin (~1pt) gray-blue outline (exact hex not captured).
7. Spokes: from the circle center draw 12 dotted red #CC3333 lines (~1pt, dotted) at 30° intervals (0°, 30°, 60°, 90°, 120°, 150°, 180°, 210°, 240°, 270°, 300°, 330°; 0° = 3 o'clock, increasing counterclockwise), each extending beyond the rim: the four cardinal spokes (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°) reach nearly to the frame (~2× the radius), the eight diagonal spokes extend ~1.6× the radius (approximate).
8. Word chip 0: rectangle ~5% wide × ~2% tall, fill mint green #CCFFCC, ~1pt green #009933 border, text 'Word 0' in Arial bold italic 12pt #009933; centered at ~78% width / ~53% height on the 0° spoke, unrotated (horizontal).
9. Word chip 1: same size, fill, border, and text style; text 'Word 1'; centered at ~76% / ~37% on the ~35° spoke, rotated ~35° so its long axis lies along the spoke.
10. Word chip 2: same style; text 'Word 2'; centered at ~69% / ~24% on the ~65° spoke, rotated ~65°.
11. Word chip 3: same style; text 'Word 3'; centered at ~60% / ~20% on the 90° spoke, rotated 90° (vertical, reading bottom-to-top).
12. Word chip 4: same style; text 'Word 4'; centered at ~51% / ~24% on the ~120° spoke, rotated ~120°.
13. Arrow 1: thin (~1pt) curved connector in orange #E06010 with a small filled triangular arrowhead, arcing counterclockwise just outside the chips from 'Word 0' to 'Word 1'; arrowhead lands on the 'Word 1' chip.
14. Arrow 2: same style, arcing counterclockwise from 'Word 1' to 'Word 2'; arrowhead on 'Word 2'.
15. Arrow 3: same style, from 'Word 2' to 'Word 3'; arrowhead on 'Word 3'.
16. Arrow 4: same style, from 'Word 3' to 'Word 4'; arrowhead on 'Word 4'.
17. Label 1: text box '+ω' in Arial bold 14pt red #CC0000 centered at ~85% width / ~42% height, to the right of the Word 0→1 arc.
18. Label 2: '+ω' in the same style centered at ~80% / ~18%, above the Word 1→2 arc.
19. Label 3: '+ω' in the same style centered at ~66% / ~13%, above the Word 2→3 arc.
20. Label 4: '+ω' in the same style centered at ~54% / ~13%, above the Word 3→4 arc.
21. Badge: oval centered at ~91% width / ~13% height, ~4% wide × ~7% tall, fill yellow #FFFF99, ~1.5pt dark-navy #333344 outline, with '27' centered in Arial bold 14pt dark navy #333344.
22. Letterbox (video artifact — include only if reproducing the video frame): solid black #000000 rectangle across the full slide width at the very bottom, ~4% tall (y ≈ 96%–100%); omit for a clean slide.
23. Do not recreate the frozen mouse cursor visible at ~61% width / ~42% height — it is a screen-capture artifact, not slide content.

fixes_applied: Populated the empty required field verbatim_text.bullets with the slide's only body text — the three equation-box lines 'Sin(ω t)', 'Cos(ω t)', 't=0,1,2,3,....' (they duplicate verbatim_text.equations; the checklist places them once, in the equation box, step 5).

Fixed recreation_brief background contradiction: the original step 1 set the whole background to #EAEAEA, but colors.background specifies white outside the dark-red frame; the checklist now uses a white #FFFFFF background with a #EAEAEA canvas rectangle inside the frame.
Corrected the word-chip border color in the checklist from the unsupported #339933 to #009933 (per the diagram element's colors and colors.accents).

Harmonized the spoke color: colors.accents grouped the spokes under #CC0000, contradicting the diagram element's color array (#CC3333 for spokes, #CC0000 for the '+ω' labels); spokes are set to #CC3333 and the accents list now separates them.

Fixed the title line-3 indent: the original checklist said '~2 characters', but layout.regions specifies line 3 'roughly under the middle of line 2' — an ≈6-character indent for 'as angles' under 'Positions are defined'.

Precision fix in layout.hierarchy: 'circle ~half the slide area' corrected to 'diagram region occupies roughly the right half of the slide (~45%–95% width, ~10%–95% height)' to match layout.regions; layout.arrangement's 'right two-thirds' changed to 'right half (~45%–95% width)' and Word 4's clock position stated exactly as ~11 o'clock (= ~120°).
Specified the badge text fully: '27' in Arial bold 14pt dark navy #333344 (the only dark color in the badge palette; size per typography_notes).
Rewrote recreation_brief as a 23-step ordered checklist with exactly one element per step, each carrying exact text, position, color, and shape.
Kept subtitle_or_header null — no subtitle or running header exists on this slide; none was invented.
uncertain_items: Exact hex codes for the equation-box border ('thin gray-olive') and the circle outline ('thin gray-blue') are not captured; the checklist uses ~1pt muted-gray approximations.
Spoke overshoot lengths beyond the rim are approximations (~2× radius for cardinal spokes, ~1.6× for diagonals); the source only states 'well beyond the rim' with horizontal/vertical spokes longest.
Word-chip dimensions (~5% × 2% of slide) are estimates; the source gives no explicit chip sizes.
The frozen mouse cursor at ~61% width / ~42% height is a confirmed screen-capture artifact and is deliberately excluded from the recreation checklist (step 23).
